summary: shoplist-app beacons installer hostname and platform to a Pipedream collector on install and on require
details: The package fires on all four npm lifecycle hooks (preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare) which invoke preinstall.js. That script performs an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded third-party collector https://eo8f3m3ho26a0nm.m.pipedream.net/ with an `x-test` header carrying os.hostname() concatenated with os.platform(). The package `main` (index.js) repeats the beacon at top level on require/import, issuing an HTTPS GET to the same Pipedream endpoint with hostname and platform as query parameters (`?ecosystem=npm&package=shoplist-app&trigger=runtime&p=<platform>&h=<hostname>`). The version string 993.99.99 and the beacon shape are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe: the package exists only to notify the operator when an internal name resolves to this public package on an installer's machine. Host identifiers are exfiltrated to an author-controlled request-bin with no opt-in and no first-party service relationship.
